messages:
maria-ops: Quick heads-up — I'm proposing the new structured logging standard and pipeline changes for fleet logs (GPU provisioning, scheduler events, model-serving traces). Goal: consistent JSON fields, sampling rules, and mandatory PII redaction before logs hit our central store. Trying to get signoff + rollout plan.

alex-infra: +1. Can you post the minimal schema and sampling rules? Also curious how this affects current fluentd -> kafka staging flow.

maria-ops: Yep. Minimal JSON fields (required):
```json
{
  "ts": "2024-05-14T21:03:00Z",
  "service": "redwood-runtime",
  "env": "prod|staging|dev",
  "region": "us-west-2",
  "cluster": "gpu-pool-3",
  "node": "i-0abcd1234",
  "gpu_id": "gpu0",
  "event_type": "request|sched|error|metric|audit",
  "request_id": "req_XXXXXXXX",
  "model": "gptq-7b",
  "latency_ms": 123,
  "queue_time_ms": 12,
  "user_id_hash": "sha256:...",
  "message": "short freeform summary"
}
```
Requirements: user_id must be a hash or omitted; raw PII fields must never be emitted (see redaction rules).

jun-sre: Where do we perform redaction? On host agent or in central processor? Host-side is safer but affects on-host CPU.

maria-ops: Preference is host-agent (fluentd filter) for initial redaction + schema validation. We will run a lightweight regex/hashing filter at the agent and a secondary validation step in the central processor to catch leaks. Host CPU impact estimated ~1-3% on median host (measured on a staging run).

paul-ml: A couple of ML-specific notes: embeddings/trace logs sometimes contain user prompts — treat those as PII. For inference tracing we should only keep hashed identifiers and prompt-length, not raw prompt text. Also sampling must ensure we keep 100% of error/timeout traces so we can debug model regressions.

lina-devex: We'll need SDK docs + migration guide. Also add an optional client-side envelope to compute user_id hash before sending (helpful for private deployments).

alex-infra: Pipeline changes: current flow is agent -> kafka topic logs-raw -> processors -> s3/clickhouse. Proposal: add an agent-level filter plugin that enforces schema + redaction, then route to two topics: logs-validated (100% of errors + sampled other events) and logs-metrics (for lightweight events feeding observability). This reduces downstream processing cost. Thoughts?

maria-ops: Exactly. Sampling policy (draft):
- errors, timeouts, OOMs: 100%
- warnings (slo-near, gpu-saturation alerts): 25%
- info (allocation, lifecycle): 10%
- debug/traces: 1% in prod, 10% in staging, 100% in dev
- dedicated capacity (customer tier): 50% (configurable per customer)
We will also do deterministic sampling by request_id hash so traces from the same request are kept together.

jun-sre: How do we ensure SLO dashboards still get accurate counts if we sample? We need counters emitted to Prometheus for totals.

maria-ops: Good call — logs should emit a small set of metric counters (agent-side) to Prometheus: total_requests, sampled_requests, errors_total, allocation_retries. Those metrics are full-count (no sampling) and feed the SLO dashboards. Logs supply details for incidents.

paul-ml: PII redaction rules (proposal):
- email: replace with sha256 hash, keep domain stripped. e.g., user@example.com -> sha256:user:... and drop domain if flagged.
- IPs: mask last octet for IPv4, /64 mask for IPv6
- phone numbers: remove all digits except last 2
- freeform prompts: redact entirely unless user opt-in; store only length and prompt_hash
Regex examples in agent config: `(?i)[a-z0-9._%+-]+@[a-z0-9.-]+\.[a-z]{2,}` and `\b(?:\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}\b`

lina-devex: We'll ship example agent config + unit tests for regex. Also client SDKs should expose a config flag `redact_level: strict|standard|off` for private deploys. Default strict for prod.

alex-infra: What about retention and cold storage cost? If we keep 100% of errors but sample others, estimate: current raw flow is ~12 TB/day. With sampling estimate drop to ~2.5 TB/day and validated index down to ~400 GB/day. Need to run cost model for S3 + ClickHouse. Ops team, can you run a 30-day projection?

maria-ops: I'll push a spreadsheet after this thread. Short term we plan a 2-week canary in us-west-2 staging: enable schema validation + redaction at agent, route to logs-validated topic with sampling turned up to 30% (staging). If canary looks good we'll roll to prod with sampling rules above and a 72h full-audit window where central processor also runs leak-checks.

jun-sre: Alerts to tune: any new schema validation failures should be an INFO-only alert for the canary, then elevated to P1 if >0.1% of messages fail in prod. Also add an alert for agent cpu > 15% sustained after enabling filters.

logbot: [bot] Canary deployment scheduled: staging/us-west-2 on 2024-06-02T03:00:00Z by maria-ops. Will post rollout status updates. :robot_face:

paul-ml: One more: ensure GPU-specific fields are present for per-GPU SLOs: `gpu_util_pct`, `gpu_mem_free_mb`, `tenant_id_hash`. We'll add these to the required+optional list.

maria-ops: Thanks. Next steps: 1) alex/infra to add agent filter plugin PR, 2) lina to draft SDK + migration docs, 3) paul to produce ML-field spec, 4) jun to add alert rules change. Can everyone ack by EOD?

alex-infra: Ack. I'll open the PR with config example and perf numbers.

jun-sre: Ack. I'll draft alert playbook and threshold tests.

paul-ml: Ack, will add ML spec and examples of sanitized traces.

lina-devex: Ack — docs + quickstart coming.

maria-ops: Great — I'll assemble the rollout checklist and reply here with the canary runbook. Thanks all! :thumbsup:
